senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Aḥiyah, several men of various periods.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:1">Shek. V, 1</cite> <he>א׳ על הנסכים</he> A. superintendent of the Temple libations (wines, oils).
<cite ref="Berakhot 63b:1">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> A., a Babylonian scholar opposing Palestine authorities.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 20b:3">Ibid. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ חייא לחוד וכ׳</he> R. Ḥiya (although a Chald. abbreviation of Aḥiyah) and R. A. are two different persons.
